en: An old Russian Empire era postcard back, printed in Russian and French with red pre-printed text and a red imperial Russian postage stamp in the upper right corner. The layout has designated sections for correspondence and address. There is a circular postal cancellation over the stamp and handwritten cursive text in black ink across the left and right sides. Publisher information is printed in small red text along the bottom edge.
